name: repowise
description: Fleet RepoWise workspace MCP pinned at C:/Repos. Plugin-gated: a small stdio bridge forwards to the one shared server on 127.0.0.1:7339 and starts it (hidden, fail-closed on the embedder) when a host connects and the port is down; no session-start or scheduled server process. Official RepoWise marketplace plugins are forbidden — they register a second MCP at the nearest repo.
